recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If the stale checked-in CarePlan SVG references to the removed top-level elements are considered build-significant, address them through the diagram generation/source pipeline or the FHIR-40500 family rather than by reopening FHIR-11343 semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-11343 was a Published/Persuasive Patient Care change request from the DSTU2 ballot asking to add top-level CarePlan.definition so a care plan could identify the protocol, questionnaire, guideline, or other specification it should be conducted in accordance with.
initial_application: Commit c124072d7bc14dd9eea48ac1aaf530bcd31171a6 added CarePlan.definition with the requested definition text and GF#11343 notes. Later workflow-alignment commits moved the same concept to CarePlan.instantiates and then to CarePlan.instantiatesCanonical/CarePlan.instantiatesUri.
additional_context: FHIR-40500 is an Applied/Persuasive with Modification Patient Care decision to remove instantiatesCanonical and instantiatesUri from CarePlan and related PC resources because workflow patterns replaced ambiguous instantiates usage with more precise workflow extensions. Core commit 6089508bef052459893cbb963f5661f217f0ece3 removed the top-level CarePlan instantiates elements, and combined-branch commit bd6bc0311a688705f65e2babecab294d145acb10 already reconciled FHIR-40500. Current authoritative CarePlan source has no top-level CarePlan.definition or CarePlan.instantiates[x], retains activity-level plannedActivityDetail.instantiatesCanonical/Uri, and records the removed top-level instantiates[x] entries only as R5-to-R6 deletion metadata in fhir.ini.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Re-adding a top-level CarePlan.definition or instantiates[x] element would conflict with later applied Patient Care workflow-pattern intent and duplicate FHIR-40500 work already present on the combined branch.

related_jiras.note: Applied Patient Care decision that removed top-level CarePlan.instantiatesCanonical and CarePlan.instantiatesUri, superseding the top-level CarePlan.definition/instantiates lineage from FHIR-11343; it was already represented on the combined branch.
